subject: Acceptance ceremony & Day-One slot allocation — final MAP and signature cadence
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Acceptance ceremony & Day-One slot allocation — final MAP and signature cadence

Marta —

Attaching the updated mutual action plan (Final_MAP_v4.pdf) with two small edits: 1) executive signoff window narrowed to 48 hours after legal clearance, and 2) a proposed Day-One onboarding slot on Mon 2025-08-04 (we've blocked initial capacity).

High level asks from our side so we can lock dates:
- Confirm which exec will sign (name & email) and their availability during 7/21–7/23.
- Procurement: expected PO issuance date and whether we should route through DocuSign or your internal e-sign process.
- Any final compliance evidence needed (Camila is on copy to coordinate).

If we get verbal go by end-of-week, we can prep the e-sign packet and reserve the onboarding slot; signature can be scheduled as a short executive ceremony (15–20 minutes).

Attachments: [Final_MAP_v4.pdf (PDF, 125KB)]

Thanks —
Hannah

hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

Cc: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@cartograph.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@cartograph.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 10:25:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Acceptance ceremony & Day-One slot allocation — final MAP and signature cadence

Hannah —

Thanks for the update and the MAP. We reviewed internally and the changes look good. A few items from our side:
- Executive sig: our COO, Luis Herrera (luis.herrera@cartograph.com), will sign. He is available for quick approvals on 7/22 (late morning) or 7/23 (early afternoon).
- Procurement: we expect the PO to be approved by 7/21; procurement@cartograph.com handles the PO/e-sign routing. We generally prefer DocuSign but can accept a vendor-generated link if it matches our PO reference.
- Compliance: Camila, could you confirm whether you need SOC 2 attachments or the summary is sufficient?

If you can align a 7/22 signature window, we should be able to meet the 8/4 onboarding start.

Best,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Partnerships | Cartograph Systems

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Acceptance ceremony & Day-One slot allocation — final MAP and signature cadence

Perfect — thanks Marta.

Camila: procurement prefers DocuSign but Marta notes they will accept a vendor-generated link if we include the PO reference. Can you attach the SOC2 summary and the logs snapshot to the e-sign packet? That should be sufficient for their legal.

Ben/Jordan: can you confirm the onboarding staffing plan for week-of-8/4 so we can confirm the Day-One agenda in the MAP? We currently have: 1x Solutions Architect (Ben), 1x Onboarding PM (Jordan) — please reply with any changes.

I will tentatively hold 7/22 11:00–11:30 PT for the executive ceremony and will send a DocuSign packet by 7/21 if procurement confirms PO issuance.

—Hannah

Hannah / team —

I'll bundle the SOC 2 summary and the last-30d audit log snapshot into the e-sign packet. Two notes:
1) For procurement, please include a simple data-retention clause (one paragraph) and a contact for incident escalation in the DocuSign cover letter. I've drafted suggested text and attached as Cartograph_Esign_Packet.docx.
2) Legal will need the exact signer name to populate the DocuSign identity verification; Marta, can you confirm Luis' preferred phone number (or whether he prefers an email-only flow)?

I'll push the draft packet to Hannah by EOD 7/14 so we can get final procurement confirmation.

Ben: team confirmed for Day-One and will circulate the Day-One agenda by 7/25. Jordan: please send the 8/4 09:00–11:00 welcome calendar invite once we have final attendee list — I've attached DayOne-Onboarding-Slots.ics for the tentative room.
